name: problem_solver
notes: The standalone generalist, outside the pipeline. Ranked first because kodo-vsix starts a brand-new session on it, so the picker reads top-down in the order a user meets them. It is not the `default`, though: the default is the fallback for an unrecognized selection, which has always resolved to the Guide.
label: Problem Solver
description: One generalist agent tackles your request end to end.
